'''João Donizeti Silvestre''' (born 11 July 1961) is a [[Brazilians|Brazilian]] businessman, historian, [[biologist]] and politician who served as an [[Alderman]] of [[Sorocaba]], Brazil.

== Career ==

His public vocation appeared at a young age, when he began to devote himself to community activities. Donizeti participated in non-profit organizations dedicated to the preservation of the environment in Brazil and Europe, and projects to promote ecological awareness, stimulate cultural development. His community leadership led him to the presidency of Neighborhoods Friend Society for over ten years, and to become a member of the boards of several international NGOs. In the 1980s, João attended the University of Sorocaba and the Autonomous University of Madrid. He graduated with a [[Bachelor of Business Administration]] and History. Later, Donizeti attended the Federal University of São Carlos.<ref name="almamater"/><ref name="cam">[http://www.camarasorocaba.sp.gov.br/sitecamara/vereadores/joaodonizetti.htm Câmara Municipal de Sorocaba]</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.redebomdia.com.br/blog/detalhe/15281/tucano-ainda-tem |title=Tucano ainda tem... |access-date=25 December 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151225180822/http://www.redebomdia.com.br/blog/detalhe/15281/tucano-ainda-tem |archive-date=25 December 2015 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In the 2012 Brazilian municipal elections, he was not reelected, despite 6,144 votes, the most among [[alderman]] in Sorocaba.<ref name="Cruzeiro9">{{cite web |url=http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=425356 |title=Vitória de dois candidatos aguarda decisão do TSE |accessdate=28 December 2012 |date=9 October 2012 |author=Jornal Cruzeiro do Sul |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121012041655/http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=425356 |archive-date=12 October 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Donizeti's candidacy was contested due to the rejection of the accounts in the City Hall of Sorocaba in 2004, when he was the Speaker of the council. His appeal was rejected by Laurita Vaz, Minister of the [[Superior Electoral Court]], who considered that Donizeti was guilty of improper conduct.<ref name="Cruzeiro8">{{cite web |url=http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=439453 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130424123010/http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=439453 |url-status=dead |archive-date=24 April 2013 |title=TSE rejeita recurso de João Donizeti |accessdate=28 December 2012 |date=7 December 2012 |author=Jornal Cruzeiro do Sul }}</ref><ref name="Cruzeiro10">{{cite web |url=http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=439520 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130424120124/http://www.cruzeirodosul.inf.br/acessarmateria.jsf?id=439520 |url-status=dead |archive-date=24 April 2013 |title=João Donizeti irá recorrer decisão do TSE |accessdate=28 December 2012 |date=7 December 2012 |author=Jornal Cruzeiro do Sul }}</ref>
During his 20 years in the Municipality of Sorocaba, João participated in the committees of education, culture, public health, sports and sustainability. He was the President of the Municipal Council for Economic Development.

Among prominent laws during his tenure were provisions requiring the offer of biodegradable or reusable bags in supermarkets, prohibiting forest fires in the city, prohibiting the burning of straw of cane sugar, creating of green sidewalks, creating the Municipal Preservation System of Springs and Streams and increasing aid to poor parents of twins.<ref name="cam"/><ref name="cruzeiro2015">{{cite web|url=http://www.jornalcruzeiro.com.br/materia/643929/o-espaco-do-cidadao |title= O espaço do cidadão |accessdate=25 December 2015 |date=2 October 2015 |author=Jornal Cruzeiro do Sul}}</ref><ref>[http://eleicoes.uol.com.br/2012/candidatos/2012/vereador/sp/11071961-joao-donizeti.htm JOAO DONIZETI]</ref><ref>[https://www3.bcb.gov.br/CALCIDADAO/publico/corrigirPelaPoupanca.do?method=corrigirPelaPoupanca Resultado da Correção pela Poupança]</ref> Since the 1990s João is a part of [[United Nations Environment Programme]].<ref name="diariosp">{{cite web|url=http://www.diariosp.com.br/blog/detalhe/4047/Crespo+esta+forte |title= Crespo está forte |accessdate=15 December 2015 |date=31 January 2012 |author=Diário de São Paulo}}</ref> He still being a popular political leader and [[environmental activist]] in Latin America and Europe.<ref>[http://agencia.sorocaba.sp.gov.br/prefeitura-inaugura-creche-no-jardim-alegria-regiao-do-eden/ Prefeitura inaugura creche no Jardim Alegria, região do Éden]</ref><ref name="diariosorocaba">{{cite web|url=http://www.diariodesorocaba.com.br/noticia/222778 |title= TSE considera que Amary é Ficha Limpa; Pannunzio segue pendente |accessdate=25 December 2015 |date=2 October 2012 |author=Diário de Sorocaba}}</ref><ref name="cruzeiro2013">{{cite web |url=http://www.jornalcruzeiro.com.br/materia/511977/joao-donizeti-podera-ser-candidato-a-deputado-estadual |archive-url=https://archive.today/20160920103540/http://www.jornalcruzeiro.com.br/materia/511977/joao-donizeti-podera-ser-candidato-a-deputado-estadual |url-status=dead |archive-date=20 September 2016 |title=João Donizeti poderá ser candidato a deputado estadual |accessdate=25 December 2015 |date=29 October 2013 |author=Jornal Cruzeiro do Sul }}</ref>

However, in November 2015 the [[Electoral Justice]] considered João Donizeti Silvestre finally not guilty. In October 2016 he was elected for the sixth term as city councilor of Sorocaba with 4,107 votes.<ref name="joao2016">{{cite web|url=http://placar.eleicoes.uol.com.br/2016/1turno/sp/sorocaba/ |title=  Eleições 2016 Apuração 1º turno FONTE: TSE |access-date=9 October 2016 |date=2 October 2016 |author=[[Universo Online|UOL]]}}</ref>
